biography: Aluizio Coelho, born in the heart of São Paulo, carries the spirit of Brazilian motorsport in his blood. Unlike many drivers groomed from karting, Aluizio's path was unconventional. He honed his skills navigating the chaotic streets on his motorcycle, delivering pizzas to support his family after his father's accident. His raw talent caught the eye of a local mechanic who sponsored his entry into a regional stock car series. Aluizio quickly demonstrated his aptitude, using his innate car control to compensate for his older, less reliable machine. After a few regional championships, he caught the eye of Copa Montana scouts. While some see him as an underdog coming from humble beginnings, Aluizio is determined to prove that passion and grit can overcome any obstacle. He's currently considered one of the most consistent drivers on the Copa Montana circuit, constantly surprising everyone with his ability to extract the maximum performance out of his car.
drivingStyle: Aluizio's driving style is best described as 'defensively aggressive.' He is remarkably adept at positioning his car to protect his line, making it incredibly difficult for opponents to overtake him. While not always the fastest in qualifying, he excels in race conditions, managing his tires with exceptional care and capitalizing on the mistakes of others. He thrives under pressure, displaying a remarkable ability to remain calm and collected even in the most challenging circumstances. Some might say he's not the flashiest driver, but his consistent points finishes make him a formidable competitor.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision in the 2022 Interlagos race, where Vargas accused Aluizio of deliberately blocking him.
A strategic rivalry; Monteiro, known for aggressive overtaking, often clashes with Coelho's defensive style, leading to tense battles on the track.
A title fight in the 2023 season saw both drivers locked in a fierce points battle. Off-track tensions grew as Oliveira's team accused Coelho of sandbagging during practice.

quirks: Always wears the same faded blue racing gloves, claiming they bring him luck.
Listens to a specific samba song before every race to calm his nerves.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his steering wheel before each session, regardless of its condition.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about raw speed alone; it's about outsmarting your opponents and making every single opportunity count."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2023 Copa Montana race at Curitiba after starting from P12, showcasing his exceptional race management and overtaking skills in tricky conditions.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2022 Interlagos race due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential championship victory.
